title: PendingDoseConfirmation carries the originally-selected given time
description: So the too-soon-confirmed retry (task-018) re-uses the exact time the user picked in AddDoseDialog, rather than capturing a fresh 'now' at confirm-click time.
acceptance_criteria: New field added: val givenAtEpochMillis: Long, placed right after doseAmount and before minutesRemaining
The other four existing fields (profileId, medicationId, doseAmount, minutesRemaining, notifyOnNextDose) are unchanged
exact_code:
private data class PendingDoseConfirmation(
    val profileId: Int,
    val medicationId: Int,
    val doseAmount: String,
    val givenAtEpochMillis: Long,
    val minutesRemaining: Long,
    val notifyOnNextDose: Boolean,
)
